jobs.description:
Tu souhaites découvrir comment fonctionne un moteur ? Le monde des machines éveille ta curiosité ? Tu as envie d'intégrer une équipe dynamique d'apprenti·es dans un environnement moderne et à la pointe de la technologie ? Liebherr Machines Bulle SA forme des apprenti·es depuis 1981 et chaque année une vingtaine de jeunes obtiennent leur CFC après 3 ou 4 ans d'apprentissage dans notre entreprise. Durée de l’apprentissage : 4 ans – du 1er août 2027 au 31 juillet 2031 Tes missions Derrière chaque pièce fabriquée se trouve d’abord une idée, puis un dessin. Pendant tes quatre années d’apprentissage :
• Tu étudies et conçois des systèmes mécaniques d'outils et de machines diverses
• Tu établis et modélises en 2D/3D, sur ordinateur, la documentation technique, comme les dessins de fabrication des pièces, les dessins d'ensemble, de montage et d'entretien ainsi que leurs listes de pièces
• Tu travailles sur des projets au sein des différents bureaux techniques (Hydraulique, Moteurs Diesel et Gabarits), en collaboration avec les responsables des ateliers de production
• Tu as des contacts directs avec la production et la fabrication et y effectues différents stages Ton profil
• Tu as terminé ta scolarité obligatoire et tu possèdes de bonnes aptitudes en mathématiques, en informatique et en dessin technique
• Tu t’intéresses à la mécanique, à la technique et à la conception
• Tu apprécies travailler sur ordinateur et souhaites apprendre à maîtriser des logiciels de conception et de dessin technique
• Tu as une bonne capacité de représentation spatiale
• Tu fais preuve d’une facilité de contact et d’un bon esprit de collaboration
• Tu travailles avec soin, précision et exactitude
• Tu es doté·e d’un esprit logique, méthodique et curieux Notre offre Chez Liebherr Machines Bulle, tu bénéficieras d’une formation complète et variée, qui combine conception technique et découverte du terrain. Grâce à notre système de stages dans différents secteurs, tu découvriras plusieurs activités et métiers tout en développant progressivement tes compétences. Tes formateurs·trices qualifié·es t’accompagneront tout au long de ton parcours pour t’aider à maîtriser les outils de conception, développer ta compréhension technique, gagner en autonomie et prendre progressivement confiance dans ton métier. Pour la rentrée 2027, nous recherchons plusieurs apprenti·es et c'est avec plaisir que nous attendons ta postulation en ligne. Afin que nous puissions prendre en compte ta candidature, pense à joindre ton CV, ta lettre de motivation, les copies de tes résultats scolaires et autres diplômes. Afin de garantir une procédure de candidature équitable, nous n’acceptons pas les candidatures par courrier postal ou électronique. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Lisa SCHNEIDER. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company Liebherr Machines Bulle SA est le centre de compétences des moteurs à combustion (diesel et gaz) et composants hydrauliques. L’entreprise développe et fabrique des produits diversifiés utilisés dans le génie civil, l'exploitation minière, l'agriculture, l'énergie décentralisée, l'ingénierie mécanique et industrielle ainsi que l'aviation. Location Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Suisse (CH) Contact Lisa SCHNEIDER 026 913 31 11

jobs.title: Service-Techniker Autokrane (m/w)

titleByLocale.fr: Grues auto de technicien de service (h/f)

jobs.description:
Du liebst starke Maschinen, moderne Technik und abwechslungsreiche Einsätze? Dann bist du bei Liebherr genau richtig. Als Service-Techniker Autokrane sorgst du dafür, dass unsere modernsten Krane jederzeit einsatzbereit sind. Ob Inbetriebnahme von Neugeräten, technische Störungen oder anspruchsvolle Reparaturen – kein Tag ist wie der andere. Dich erwarten spannende Einsätze in der ganzen Schweiz, hohe Eigenverantwortung und direkter Kundenkontakt. Das sind deine Aufgaben
• Du stellst Neugeräte bereit, nimmst sie in Betrieb und führst Geräteübergaben sowie Einweisungen bei unseren Kunden durch.
• Du führst Service-, Wartungs- und Inspektionsarbeiten an unseren Autokranen durch.
• Du analysierst technische Störungen und führst Reparaturen direkt beim Kunden oder an unserem Standort in Reiden aus.
• Du führst SUVA-Krankontrollen in der ganzen Schweiz durch.
• Du erledigst Garantiearbeiten sowie technische Änderungen gemäss den aktuellen Service-Informationen.
• Du berätst und unterstützt unsere Kunden kompetent vor Ort sowie telefonisch.
• Du dokumentierst deine Einsätze in Service-, Wartungs- und Inspektionsrapporten und koordinierst bei Bedarf Ersatzteile mit internen und externen Stellen.
• Du pflegst langfristige Kundenbeziehungen und repräsentierst Liebherr professionell bei jedem Einsatz. Das bringst du mit
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Landmaschinen-, Lastwagen-, Baumaschinenmechaniker EFZ, Automobil-Mechatroniker EFZ oder Motorgerätemechaniker EFZ.
• Idealerweise Erfahrung im technischen Servicebereich oder im Umfeld von Mobilbau- oder Autokranen. Motivierte Berufsleute mit Entwicklungspotenzial prüfen wir ebenfalls gerne.
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Französischkenntnisse. Weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus.
• Führerausweis Kategorie B sowie idealerweise Kategorie E oder C beziehungsweise die Bereitschaft, diese zu erwerben.
• Freude an direktem Kundenkontakt und selbstständigem Arbeiten.
• Bereitschaft für Reisetätigkeit in der ganzen Schweiz sowie gelegentliche Einsätze im angrenzenden Ausland.
• Wohnort vorzugsweise im Raum Bern, Zürich, Basel oder Luzern. Darauf kannst du dich freuen
• Ein kleines, schlagkräftiges Team mit grossem Zusammenhalt
• Eigener Servicewagen mit modernen Arbeitsmitteln
• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und laufende technische Weiterbildungen
• Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns über Deine Online-Bewerbung. Bei Fragen kontaktiere bitte Susanne Sulzer. One Passion. Many Opportunities. Das Unternehmen ​ Die Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG mit Sitz in Reiden (Schweiz) ist verantwortlich für den Vertrieb und Service von Erdbewegungs- und Materialumschlagmaschinen, Turmdrehkranen, Betontechnik, Spezialtiefbaumaschinen sowie Mobil- und Raupenkranen in der Schweiz. Standort Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG Industriestrasse 18 6260 Reiden Schweiz (CH) Kontakt Susanne Sulzer 062 785 82 00

jobs.description:
Tu souhaites rejoindre une bonne équipe ? Tu es passionné par la technique et apprécies travailler avec les machines de terrassement ? Rejoins-nous et deviens conseiller technique pour le service après-vente des machines de terrassement Liebherr à Daillens. Voici ce que tu feras chez nous
• Assurer le conseil technique à la clientèle pour répondre à leurs besoins spécifique
• Fournir une assistance technique aux techniciens de service et aux mécaniciens
• Clarifications techniques avec les fabricants et les fournisseurs pour validation
• Garantir le suivi complet des processus, de la demande de prix à la facturation finale
• Apporter un assistance à la planification dans le cadre de la préparation du travail pour les interventions de montage Ce que tu apportes
• CFC de mécanicien de chantier, -de machine agricole, -de poids lourds ou une formation équivalente
• Formation continue (commercial / technique)
• Expérience professionnelle comme mécanicien sur des machines de chantier ou des machines équivalentes
• Maîtrise des systèmes MS Office
• L'allemand un plus Ce que nous t'offrons
• Un emploi où chaque jour est différent
• Des machines et une technologie fascinantes qui suscitent l'enthousiasme
• Flexibilité grâce à des horaires de travail et une infrastructure moderne
• Une équipe solide au sein d'un groupe d'entreprises prospère
• Des prestations sociales et des avantages attractifs Avons-nous suscité ton intérêt ? Si c’est le cas, nous serions ravis de recevoir ta candidature en ligne. Si tu as des questions, merci de contacter Virginie Lüscher. One Passion. Many Opportunities. *Une passion commune. Tant d’opportunités. L'entreprise Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG, basée à Reiden (Suisse), est chargée de la vente et du service des engins de terrassement, de la technologie de manutention, des machines pour fondations spéciales, des grues à tour, de la technique du béton et des grues mobiles et sur chenilles en Suisse. ​​ Site Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG Z.I. Les Graveys D 1306 Daillens Suisse (CH) Contact Virginie Lüscher +41 21 863 60 03

jobs.description:
Als Werkstudentin oder Werkstudent unterstützen Sie unser HR-Team im operativen Tagesgeschäft und erhalten spannende Einblicke in vielfältige Personalthemen. Aufgaben:
• Unterstützung bei administrativen HR-Prozessen vom Eintritt bis zum Austritt
• Erstellung von Arbeitszeugnissen, Bestätigungen und weiteren HR-Dokumenten
• Mithilfe bei der Pflege und Verwaltung von Personaldaten
• Unterstützung im Bewerbermanagement und Recruiting
• Unterstützung bei der Organisation von Schulungen und Onboarding-Massnahmen
• Mitarbeit in HR-Projekten und Unterstützung bei Prozessoptimierungen
• Erstellung von Auswertungen, Präsentationen und Statistiken Qualifikation:
• Laufendes Studium mit Vertiefung im Bereich Human Resources, Psychologie oder vergleichbarer Studienrichtung
• Interesse an Human Resources und administrativen Prozessen
• Selbstständige, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise
• Hohe Diskretion und Vertrauenswürdigkeit im Umgang mit sensiblen Daten
• Gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse und Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil Unser Angebot: Können wir Sie begeistern, in einem dynamischen und unabhängigen Familienunternehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe zu übernehmen? Wir bieten Ihnen Freiräume für Ideen, einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz, fortschrittliche und familienfreundliche Anstellungsbedingungen wie flexible Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice sowie Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns über Ihre Online-Bewerbung. Bei Fragen kontaktieren Sie bitte Gina Aeberhard. Bitte beachten Sie, dass Bewerbungen via E-Mail nicht berücksichtigt werden. One Passion. Many Opportunities. Das Unternehmen ​ Die Liebherr-International AG mit Sitz in Bulle ist die Dachgesellschaft der Firmengruppe Liebherr und nimmt vielfältige Funktionen in den Bereichen Finanzen, Steuern, Revision, Recht, Versicherungswesen, Personal und Unternehmenskommunikation wahr. Die Firmengruppe Liebherr beschäftigt weltweit mehr als 55.000 Mitarbeitende in über 150 Gesellschaften. Standort Liebherr-International AG 5415 Nussbaumen Schweiz (CH) Kontakt Gina Aeberhard gina.aeberhard@liebherr.com

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come studente di lavoro, sosterrai il nostro team di risorse umane nelle operazioni quotidiane e acquisirai interessanti insight su una vasta gamma di argomenti HR. Compiti:
• Supporto per processi amministrativi HR dall'ingresso all'uscita
• Creazione di certificati di lavoro, conferme e altri documenti HR
• Assistenza nel mantenimento e nella gestione dei dati personali
• Sostegno alla gestione e al reclutamento dei candidati
• Sostegno all'organizzazione di misure di formazione e di imbarco
• Partecipazione a progetti HR e supporto per l'ottimizzazione dei processi
• Preparazione di valutazioni, presentazioni e statistiche
• Studi in corso con specializzazione in risorse umane, psicologia o campi comparabili di studio
• Interessi delle risorse umane e dei processi amministrativi
• Metodi di lavoro indipendenti, strutturati e attenti
• Alta discrezione e affidabilità nel trattamento dei dati sensibili
• Buona SM Capacità di ufficio, in particolare Excel e PowerPoint
• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco, buona conoscenza dell'inglese e del francese La nostra offerta: Possiamo ispirarvi a assumere un compito responsabile in un business familiare dinamico e indipendente? Vi offriamo la libertà di idee, un luogo di lavoro sicuro, condizioni di lavoro progressivo e familiare, come orari di lavoro flessibili, ufficio di casa e ulteriori opportunità di istruzione. Abbiamo suscitato il vostro interesse? Quindi non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione online. Per qualsiasi domanda, si prega di contattare Gina Aeberhard. Si prega di notare che le applicazioni via e-mail non sono considerate. Una passione. Molte opportunità. L'azienda Liebherr-International AG, con sede a Bulle, è la società a ombrello del Gruppo Liebherr e svolge una vasta gamma di funzioni nei settori della finanza, fiscale, audit, legale, assicurativo, personale e comunicazioni aziendali. Il Gruppo Liebherr impiega oltre 55.000 persone in oltre 150 aziende in tutto il mondo. Luogo Liebherr-International AG 5415 Nussbaumen Svizzera (CH) Contatto Gina Aeberhard gina.aeberhard@liebherr.com
descriptionByLocale.en:
As a working student, you will support our HR team in day-to-day operations and gain exciting insights into a wide range of HR topics. Tasks:
• Support for administrative HR processes from entry to exit
• Creation of employment certificates, confirmations and other HR documents
• Assistance in the maintenance and management of personal data
• Support in applicant management and recruitment
• Support for the organisation of training and onboarding measures
• Participation in HR projects and support for process optimization
• Preparation of evaluations, presentations and statistics Qualification:
• Ongoing studies with specialisation in human resources, psychology or comparable fields of study
• Interest in human resources and administrative processes
• Independent, structured and careful working methods
• High discretion and trustworthiness in handling sensitive data
• Good MS Office skills, especially Excel and PowerPoint
• Very good knowledge of German, good knowledge of English and French Our offer: Can we inspire you to take on a responsible task in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you freedom for ideas, a secure workplace, progressive and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office and further education opportunities. Have we aroused your interest? Then we look forward to your online application. For any questions, please contact Gina Aeberhard. Please note that applications via e-mail are not considered. One passion. Many opportunities. The company Liebherr-International AG, headquartered in Bulle, is the umbrella company of the Liebherr Group and performs a wide range of functions in the areas of finance, tax, audit, legal, insurance, personnel and corporate communications. The Liebherr Group employs more than 55,000 people in over 150 companies worldwide. Location Liebherr-International AG 5415 Nussbaumen Switzerland (CH) Contact Gina Aeberhard gina.aeberhard@liebherr.com

jobs.title: Head of Data Security (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
We are expanding our Global Corporate Information Security Team and looking forward new colleagues and leaders joining us in Bulle (FR) Switzerland, we are looking for a Head of Data Security reporting to Head of Digital Security at Liebherr International. The scope of duties includes the following: Responsibilities: Oversees the organization’s global data security strategy and implementation to protect sensitive data assets across IT, OT and Cloud Environments, as well as Global Leadership of Data Security Team, Products and Services.
• Develop and implement a comprehensive data security strategy aligned with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
• Oversee data security, labeling, and access control mechanisms in collaboration with Data Governance.
• Implement and manage data encryption and data loss prevention (DLP) solutions.
• Manage data encryption and key management systems (e.g. PKI)
• Develop and enforce data protection strategies, and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR) in collaboration with Data Protection.
• Conduct regular risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities in data storage, processing, and transmission.
• Collaborate with IT, legal, and business teams to secure sensitive data across all platforms.
• Manage incident response for data breaches, including investigation, remediation, and reporting.
• Implement monitoring and technical auditing mechanisms to track data access and usage across the organization.
• Drive data security awareness and training programs to reinforce best practices among employees. Competencies:
• Bachelor’s/Master’s in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related field.
• 5+ years in cybersecurity and 3+ years in a leadership role.
• Following certificates are preferred; CISSP or CISM.
• English is a Must, German and French are a plus.
• Excellent knowledge of data security concepts, principles including data governance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA)
• Knowledge of data security technologies and tools (e.g., DLP, cloud encryption, tokenization).
• Experience with cryptographic solutions and protocols (e.g., PKI, PGP, KMS, HSM)
• Ability to think critically and solve complex problems
• Ability to communicate technical topics to non-technical audiences
• Ability to manage and collaborate with stakeholders
• Project management
• Readiness for global travel Our offer: We offer you a secure job, progressive and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, hybrid working and opportunities for further training Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Regina Abou el Naga. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company Liebherr-International AG with its head office in Bulle is the holding company of the Liebherr Group and performs various functions in the areas finance, tax, auditing, legal, insurance, HR, and corporate communication. The Liebherr Group employs more than 55,000 people worldwide in over 150 countries. Location Liebherr-International AG 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Regina Abou el Naga regina.abouelnaga@liebherr.com

descriptionByLocale.it:
Stiamo espandendo il nostro Global Corporate Information Security Team e aspettiamo nuovi colleghi e leader che si uniscono a noi in Bulle (FR) Svizzera, stiamo cercando un responsabile della sicurezza dei dati che segnala al capo della sicurezza digitale di Liebherr International. La portata dei compiti comprende le seguenti: Responsabilità: supervisiona la strategia globale di sicurezza dei dati dell'organizzazione e l'implementazione per proteggere le attività sensibili dei dati in ambito IT, OT e Cloud, nonché la leadership globale del team, dei prodotti e dei servizi di sicurezza dei dati.
• Sviluppare e implementare una strategia completa di sicurezza dei dati allineata agli obiettivi aziendali e ai requisiti normativi.
• Superare i meccanismi di sicurezza, etichettatura e controllo degli accessi in collaborazione con Data Governance.
• Implementare e gestire le soluzioni di crittografia dei dati e prevenzione della perdita di dati (DLP).
• Gestione della crittografia dei dati e dei sistemi di gestione delle chiavi (ad es. PKI)
• Sviluppare e far rispettare le strategie di protezione dei dati e i quadri di conformità (ad esempio, GDPR) in collaborazione con Data Protection.
• Condurre regolari valutazioni dei rischi per identificare le vulnerabilità nella memorizzazione dei dati, elaborazione e trasmissione.
• Collabora con team IT, legali e aziendali per proteggere i dati sensibili su tutte le piattaforme.
• Gestire la risposta incidente per violazioni dei dati, tra cui indagine, bonifica e reporting.
• Monitoraggio dell'esecuzione e meccanismi di audit tecnico per monitorare l'accesso dei dati e l'utilizzo in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Guidare la consapevolezza della sicurezza dei dati e programmi di formazione per rafforzare le migliori pratiche tra i dipendenti. Competenze:
• Corso di laurea / Master in Cybersecurity, Informatica, o campo relativo.

Ob Neugerät, komplexe Reparatur oder komplette Revision: Bei uns erwartet dich ein vielseitiger Arbeitsalltag mit modernster Technik, spannenden Herausforderungen und einem Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt. jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You act as the technical interface between Liebherr Ettlingen and Liebherr Machines Bulle to support coordination, alignment, and knowledge exchange for all remanufacturing topics
• You ensure the consistent integration of remanufacturing requirements throughout the product development process
• You design, document, and maintain remanufacturing products and components including CAD models, technical drawings, BOMs, and PLM data, while meeting technical, cost, quality, and schedule targets
• You work in close cooperation with interdisciplinary internal departments and suppliers to ensure technical alignment, clarification, and co‑design for remanufacturing applications
• You establish and continuously improve remanufacturing engineering processes through guidelines, best practices, and effective knowledge management to ensure efficient remanufacturing development Your Profile
• You have successfully completed engineering studies in a relevant field
• You have previous experience in combustion engine design
• You bring strong technical expertise in combustion engines (diesel required, gasoline and/or hydrogen is a plus) and a basic ability to interpret simulation results (1D, CFD, FEA, NVH…)
• You have advanced proficiency in IT tools, including MS Office, PTC Creo, and PLM Albatros, as well as basic knowledge of ERP systems
• You are autonomous, innovative, goal‑driven, and comfortable working in an international environment
• You are able and willing to travel regularly to Liebherr Ettlingen, approximately once per month
• You are fluent in English and German, and ideally in French Our Offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us. In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email. This position is subject to a background check process; the process is conducted by our partner Aequivalent. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Sylvain STUDER. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company ​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace. Location Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Sylvain STUDER +41 26 913 34 00

jobs.title: Head of Product Security (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
The Head of Product Security is responsible for ensuring the cybersecurity of Liebherr Products/Machines and related digital products throughout their entire lifecycle. The role defines and drives product security strategy, embeds security-by-design into engineering, and ensures compliance with EU product cybersecurity regulations, including the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) and NIS2, while protecting connected machines, embedded systems, and digital services. Ensuring alignment with business strategies, demands, and risk appetite, working closely with Corporate Product Security Officer, as well as the Product Security Officers/Engineers of Product Segments. Responsibilities:
• Define and lead global product security strategy, roadmap and execution for construction machines and digital products.
• Define product security controls (secure coding, vulnerability management, incident response) based on threat modelling and risk appetite.
• Act as central focal point for product security topics within Corporate Information Security and to internal/external customers for product security matters, risk, regulatory findings
• Define the product security governance framework (policies, standards, controls) and ensure adoption into R&D, engineering, and product lifecycle processes
• Sponsor, build and deploy training, awareness, and support to Engineering teams on security best practices.
• Ensure product compliance with EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2, and other applicable global regulations
• Embed security-by-design into hardware, firmware, embedded software, and connected platforms.
• Build, mentor and lead a team of product security experts. Foster collaboration with Engineering teams and across Corporate Information Security domains. Competencies:
• A degree in Engineering, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field
• At least 5 years of experience in product or embedded cybersecurity, including 3+ years in a leadership role
• Strong background in embedded systems, connected products, or industrial/IoT security
• Proven ability to translate regulatory and technical requirements into practical engineering execution
• Solid knowledge of standards and regulations such as UNECE R155/R156, EU CRA, IEC 62443, ISO 21434, NIST CSF
• Experience with security testing methods and tools (e.g. SAST, DAST, fuzzing)
• Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
• Experience in manufacturing, industrial, automotive, or heavy equipment environments is a strong advantage
• Fluent English required; German and French are a plus Our offer: We offer you a secure job, progressive and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, hybrid working and opportunities for further training. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Regina Abou el Naga. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company Liebherr-International AG with its head office in Bulle is the holding company of the Liebherr Group and performs various functions in the areas finance, tax, auditing, legal, insurance, HR, and corporate communication. The Liebherr Group employs more than 55,000 people worldwide in over 150 countries. Location Liebherr-International AG 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Regina Abou el Naga regina.abouelnaga@liebherr.com

• Wartung und Reparatur : Selbstständige Durchführung sämtlicher Wartungs-, Reparatur- und Revisionsarbeiten an Geräten der Betontechnik, inklusive gelegentlicher Beschaffung und Organisation von Ersatzteilen
• Störungsbehebung : Eigenständige Diagnose und nachhaltige Behebung technischer Störungen an Maschinen und Anlagen
• Montage und Inbetriebnahme : Vorbereitung, Installation und Inbetriebnahme von Neugeräten, Mietsystemen und Sonderkonstruktionen – sowohl im Haus als auch beim Kunden vor Ort
• Kundensupport : Technische Beratung und Betreuung unserer Kunden vor Ort; Unterstützung bei Anwendung, Unterhalt und Problemlösungen.
• Pikettdienst : zur Sicherstellung einer schnellen Reaktionszeit bei dringenden Kundenanliegen ausserhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten Das bringst du mit
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektriker, Elektroinstallateur oder gleichwertige Ausbildung (Automatiker)
• Führerausweis der Kategorie B/BE
• Interesse und Freude als Service-Techniker unterwegs zu sein
• Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der Schweiz
• Gute Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil
• Kunden- und teamorientiertes Verhalten Was wir bieten Als innovatives und modernes Unternehmen in einer erfolgreichen Firmengruppe, bieten wir dir ein vielseitiges, interessantes und anspruchsvolles Aufgabengebiet mit Entwicklungspotenzial. In einem dynamischen Umfeld bieten wir flexible Arbeitszeiten, eine moderne Infrastruktur sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen und Benefits. Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns über deine Online-Bewerbung. Bei Fragen kontaktiere bitte Susanne Sulzer. One Passion. Many Opportunities. Das Unternehmen ​ Die Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG mit Sitz in Reiden (Schweiz) ist verantwortlich für den Vertrieb und Service von Erdbewegungs- und Materialumschlagmaschinen, Turmdrehkranen, Betontechnik, Spezialtiefbaumaschinen sowie Mobil- und Raupenkranen in der Schweiz. Standort Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG Industriestrasse 18 6260 Reiden Schweiz (CH) Kontakt Susanne Sulzer 062 785 82 00

titleByLocale.it: Ingegnere di processo (m/f/x) Misura di tempo

jobs.description:
Les missions
• Intervenir directement sur le terrain pour analyser et optimiser les processus de montage, réduire les temps de cycle de production et mettre en place des standards de chronométrage
• Réaliser des études de postes et des analyses de flux afin d’identifier les gaspillages et proposer des améliorations concrètes
• Effectuer des cartographies de la chaîne de valeur (VSM) en collaboration avec les équipes terrain
• Évaluer les coûts de production et contribuer à la planification en définissant des temps standards cibles réalistes
• Recommander et mettre en place des améliorations ergonomiques, sécuritaires et organisationnelles
• Définir et déployer des bonnes pratiques industrielles standardisées et durables
• Former et accompagner les opérateurs et responsables à l’adoption des nouveaux standards et méthodes
• Documenter les processus pour assurer la continuité opérationnelle et le transfert de connaissances Profil
• Formation d'ingénieur en génie mécanique ou en génie de production
• Bonne connaissance des processus de fabrication et d’assemblage des moteurs
• Compétences en chronométrage et analyse de temps de travail
• Maîtrise du français et connaissance de l'anglais et/ou de l'allemand
• Capacité à travailler en autonomie et en équipe Notre offre Pour ce poste ouvert uniquement à l'interne, LMB propose une formation interne pour monter en compétences sur le poste :
• • Technicien REFA en Industrial Engineering
• Methods Time Measurement (MTM-1, MTM-2 et MTM-UAS)
• Accompagnement des analyses par du coaching si nécessaire Une convention de formation pour la prise en charge des coûts sera établie entre LMB et la personne qui occupera ce poste d'une durée de 3 ans. Avons-nous suscité votre intérêt ? Si c’est le cas, nous serions ravis de recevoir votre candidature en ligne. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez contacter Romain GROGNUZ. One Passion. Many Opportunities. *Une passion commune. Tant d’opportunités. L'entreprise Liebherr Machines Bulle SA est le centre de compétences des moteurs à combustion (diesel et gaz) et composants hydrauliques. L’entreprise développe et fabrique des produits diversifiés utilisés dans le génie civil, l'exploitation minière, l'agriculture, l'énergie décentralisée, l'ingénierie mécanique et industrielle ainsi que l'aviation. ​​ Site Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Suisse (CH) Contact Romain GROGNUZ 026 913 31 11

jobs.title: Control Systems Engineer (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You take ownership of system-level control design (design, simulation, V&V, …), contributing to next-generation engine control architectures and digital engineering capabilities
• You collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, experts, and customers
• You design, implement, and maintain model-based plant/system models and Model‑in‑the‑Loop (MiL) simulation environments to systematically test, analyze, and validate control functions
• You perform evidence-based trade‑off analyses to evaluate and optimize alternative technical solutions
• You support application engineers during commissioning activities at test benches and in real-world field applications
• You define system-level control specifications, including failure mode analysis, safety and cybersecurity considerations
• You analyze, evaluate and document the dynamic behavior and interactions of engine control system elements
• You design, develop and maintain engine control system architectures (hardware, software and services) with a focus on performance, quality and reusability
• You coordinate with project management and software/hardware development teams to integrate new functions and components, and continuously improve model-based systems engineering methods, processes and toolchains Your Profile
• You have successfully completed engineering studies in the field of automotive, powertrain, mechanical, mechatronics, electronics engineering, or similar
• You have solid experience in combustion engine control system development, including multi‑physics modeling, and ideally engine calibration (performance and emissions)
• You are proficient in Matlab/Simulink and embedded software engineering, with strong skills in model‑based systems engineering (MBSE) and signal processing
• You are familiar with ALM/PLM and requirements authoring tools, and MBSE environments such as System Composer, Cameo, Rhapsody or similar
• You bring an analytical mindset, high learnability, agile methods, and collaborate effectively in cross‑functional engineering teams
• You are willing and able to occasionally travel
• You are fluent in English Our Offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us. In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email. jobs.title: Group Internal Auditor (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Liebherr-International AG, headquartered in Nussbaumen, Switzerland, is the holding company of the Liebherr Group. It performs group-wide functions in the areas of Finance, Compliance, Human Resources, Legal Affairs, Internal Audit, Corporate Communications, and Insurance. Responsibilities:
• Planning and conducting operational, financial, and compliance audits at domestic and international group companies.
• Analyzing, evaluating, and optimizing business processes, as well as developing practical recommendations for improvement.
• Following up on audit findings and monitoring the implementation of agreed corrective actions.
• Advising group companies on matters related to Internal Control Systems (ICS), Corporate Governance, and Compliance.
• Analyzing and evaluating financial and management reporting of group companies.
• Preparing clear, concise, and audience-focused audit reports and presenting audit results to management. Your Profile:
• A successfully completed degree in Economics, Business Administration, or a comparable field from a university or university of applied sciences.
• At least three years of professional experience in internal auditing, external auditing, public accounting, or a comparable environment.
• Willingness to obtain the Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) qualification or an equivalent professional certification.
• Strong affinity for information technology, as well as an interest in data-driven audit approaches and digital technologies.
• Solid understanding of business processes and economic principles, combined with strong analytical thinking skills.
• A self-reliant, structured, and solution-oriented approach to work.
• Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the confidence to operate effectively in an international environment.
• Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken; additional languages are advantageous.
• Willingness to undertake international business travel of approximately 30%. Our Offer:
• Diverse and responsible tasks within an international corporate environment.
• Direct collaboration with management and business functions across the globe.
• Comprehensive insights into a wide range of business processes and companies within the Liebherr Group.
• Individual training and development opportunities, particularly in the fields of Internal Audit, Governance, and Risk Management.
• Attractive employment conditions and flexible working arrangements. jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You are responsible for the assigned products throughout its entire lifecycle
• You assess the product lifecycle and initiate measures to achieve the business unit’s targets in coordination with the key stakeholders
• You are responsible for product definition and specification based on input and/or the roadmap from the Product Strategy Office, customers, R&D, and market trends
• You are in charge of direct customer contact, including the consolidation of customer insights
• You manage and execute all market- and product-related activities (cost reduction programs, cost control, pricing strategy, profitability)
• You lead new product integrations in collaboration with Project Management and Marketing (launch materials, online content)
• You translate the innovation roadmap into profitable and differentiated value propositions
• You oversee decisions regarding the regional coverage of products and harmonize regional needs via the product-market matrix
• You support and work in close collaboration with Technical Sales, customers, and R&D to define the product strategy and portfolio of the product line
• You are responsible for providing the necessary input and managing the development of the engine configurator Your Profile
• You hold a Master’s degree in Engineering or a related field
• You bring more than 5 years of experience in product management and engineering within the combustion engine development in matrix organizations
• You possess strong knowledge of powertrain solutions for land defense applications
• You are fluent in German and English (C1) and have an excellent command of French (B2)
• You have advanced proficiency in Microsoft Project
• You are recognized for your strong commercial and customer-oriented mindset. Your enthusiastic and open personality, combined with excellent communication, adaptability, leadership, and stakeholder management skills, set you apart. You are resilient, self-confident, and assertive in your approach Our offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us. In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email. This position is subject to a background check process; the process is conducted by our partner Aequivalent. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Sylvain STUDER. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company ​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace. Location Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Sylvain STUDER +41 26 913 31 11

descriptionByLocale.it:
Le tue responsabilità
• Sei responsabile per i prodotti assegnati in tutto il suo ciclo di vita
• Valuta il ciclo di vita del prodotto e avvia misure per raggiungere gli obiettivi dell’unità aziendale in coordinamento con le principali parti interessate
• L'utente è responsabile della definizione e delle specifiche dei prodotti in base all'ingresso e/o alla roadmap del Product Strategy Office, dei clienti, della R&D e delle tendenze di mercato
• Lei è responsabile del contatto diretto del cliente, compreso il consolidamento delle intuizioni del cliente
• Gestisci ed esegui tutte le attività del mercato e del prodotto (programmi di riduzione dei costi, controllo dei costi, strategia dei prezzi, redditività)
• Conduci nuove integrazioni di prodotto in collaborazione con Project Management e Marketing (materiali di lancio, contenuti online)
• Traduci la roadmap dell'innovazione in proposte di valore redditizie e differenziate
• L'utente controlla le decisioni relative alla copertura regionale dei prodotti e armonizza le esigenze regionali tramite la matrice del mercato dei prodotti
• Supporti e lavori in stretta collaborazione con vendite tecniche, clienti e R&D per definire la strategia e il portafoglio prodotti della linea di prodotti
• Sei responsabile per fornire l'ingresso necessario e gestire lo sviluppo del configuratore motore Il tuo profilo
• Hai una laurea magistrale in Ingegneria o un campo correlato
• Porti più di 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione del prodotto e nell'ingegneria all'interno dello sviluppo del motore di combustione nelle organizzazioni di matrice
• Possiedi una forte conoscenza delle soluzioni powertrain per applicazioni di difesa della terra
• Sei fluente in tedesco e inglese (C1) e hai un eccellente comando del francese (B2)
• Hai una competenza avanzata in Microsoft Project
• Siete riconosciuti per la vostra forte mentalità commerciale e orientata al cliente. La tua personalità entusiasta e aperta, combinata con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, adattabilità, leadership e gestione degli stakeholder, ti distingue. Siete resilienti, autosufficienti e assertivi nel vostro approccio La nostra offerta Possiamo ispirarvi a assumere una posizione responsabile in un business familiare dinamico e indipendente? Vi offriamo spazio per idee, un lavoro sicuro, condizioni di lavoro moderne e familiari come orari di lavoro flessibili, ufficio di casa, un ristorante aziendale, opportunità di formazione e molti benefici. Il posto di lavoro si trova a Bulle, circondato dalla natura meravigliosa della regione di Gruyère. Inizia a pianificare il tuo sviluppo personale e professionale con noi. Al fine di garantire un corretto processo di applicazione, non possiamo accettare le applicazioni per posta o e-mail. Questa posizione è soggetta a un processo di controllo di sfondo; il processo è condotto dal nostro partner Aequivalent. Abbiamo risvegliato il vostro interesse? Allora non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online. Se hai domande, contatta Sylvain STUDER. Una Passione. Molte opportunità. L'azienda Liebherr Machines Bulle SA è il centro di eccellenza per motori a combustione (diesel e motori a gas) e componenti idraulici (pompe a pistoni assiali e motori). L'azienda sviluppa e produce vari prodotti, che trovano il loro uso nella costruzione edile e ingegneria civile, nell'estrazione mineraria, nell'agricoltura, nell'energia decentralizzata, nell'ingegneria delle macchine e degli impianti, nonché nell'aerospaziale. Luogo Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Svizzera (CH) Contatto Sylvain STUDER +41 26 913 31 11

jobs.title: Pricing Analyst / Specialist (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• In this position you will take ownership for the pricing strategy within BU AxM and drive its continuous development, defining and implementing pricing approaches based on key business drivers and market dynamics
• You will provide data-driven insights, analyses and tools to support management in shaping pricing strategies and preparing customer quotations while ensuring a solid and consistent data foundation
• You will monitor, identify and leverage additional price quotations beyond existing databases to benchmark products and parts, supporting accurate and competitive pricing decisions
• You will develop and implement IT tools that foster long-term transparency and a deeper understanding of pricing structures
• You will closely monitor product life cycle changes and manage the regular pricing updates regarding spare parts
• You will define and manage pricing strategies for specific internal and external requests, including new components, parts, kits and projects
• You will collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product Management, Controlling, Customer Service and Sales to align pricing structures, including product feature segregation, margin calculations and quotation processes
• You will support further role-related activities, including maintaining the component-machine customer database, contributing to external market development, and benchmarking within the Construction & Mining Machinery industry Your Profile
• You have successfully completed a degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance or equivalent
• You bring strong business acumen with a solid understanding of pricing, margins, value propositions and market dynamics
• You have a good understanding of high-level hydraulic component features
• You are experienced in data analysis and market research, ideally in a Data, Finance or Business Analyst role, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights
• You are proficient in MS Office, ERP systems and Power BI
• You combine strong analytical skills with a structured and detail-oriented way of working. With your business mindset, proactive approach and clear communication style, you collaborate effectively with stakeholders across different functions
• You are fluent in English and have good knowledge of German and French Our Offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? jobs.title: Test Technician (m/w/x)
jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You participate to the development and testing of Diesel and Gas engines and undertake the tasks requested to validate engine components using engines in the test benches
• You work closely and support a test engineer and act as the interface between the test engineer and workshop for the engine assembly and disassembly. You also create engine assembly requests for all development engines, including dataset, metrology and instrumentation requests
• You ensure that tasks defined and requested during engine assembly and disassembly are correctly performed and you create reports accordingly
• You request the needed measurement devices and you use some such as borescope, wrench to measure tightening and residual torque
• You are accountable for the engine bill of material and corresponding parts running time, during all engine life
• You create test program and follow testing activities on test benches and analyse the measurements and write up the associated report
• You describe mechanical failures that might occur during the testing activities, and you give support for the resolution.
• You are involved in logistic activities to move, store, send or scrap parts
• You actively participate to the continuous improvement of processes such as workflows, test procedures, assembly and disassembly procedures Your Profile
• You hold a mechanical training in heavy duty engines, a technician training, or similar
• You bring relevant experience in engine development and experience with combustion engines. A workshop and/or Test Bench experience is a plus
• You have knowledge on measuring technology and testing
• You have advanced knowledge on post-processing and ERP programs
• You are fluent in French and have good linguistic skills in English Our Offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? jobs.description:

• You are in charge of analyzing the portfolio, sorting offers, updating prices, and handling the related administrative tasks,

• You look for the best technical solutions to guarantee design-to-cost (DTC). Your Profile

• You have good knowledge of French, German, and English,
• You are proficient with an ERP system, SharePoint (intranet), and MS Office,

jobs.description:
To support our Global Transfer Pricing team in Nussbaumen AG, Switzerland, we are looking for a Transfer Pricing Working Student. In this role, you will contribute to international transfer pricing projects and support the implementation of the Group's transfer pricing strategy. Responsibilities:
• You support to the implementation of the Group's transfer pricing strategy.
• You assist in the design and monitoring of transfer pricing policies through financial analyses and benchmarking studies.
• You assist with drafting and reviewing intercompany agreements for cross-border transactions.
• You contribute to the preparation of transfer pricing documentation and ensure compliance requirements in more than 50 countries.
• You participate in transfer pricing projects through financial modelling, presentations, reports and monitoring of regulatory developments.
• You analyse financial and operational data to support transfer pricing policies and business decisions. Competencies:
• You are studying Economics, Business Administration, Law or a related field.
• You are fluent in English; German is an advantage but not compulsory.
• You are confident using Microsoft Office and SharePoint.
• You are able to understand and solve complex analytical problems.
• You are interested in a multidisciplinary field covering tax, economics, accounting, finance and business operations.
• You work accurately and pay close attention to detail.
• You have good communication, teamwork and project management skills.
• Previous work experience is welcome but not required. Our Offer
• Join a global market and technology leader with a strong international presence across 13 product segments.
• Gain practical experience in transfer pricing across more than 50 countries.
• Be part of an international team working on strategic cross-border projects.
• Collaborate closely with experts across tax, controlling, treasury, accounting, legal and operations.
• Benefit from flexible working hours that fit your academic schedule.
• Receive a competitive salary and a six-month contract with the possibility of renewal. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Jeton Tahiri. One Passion. Many Opportunities. Location Liebherr-International AG General-Guisanstrasse 6 5415 Nussbaumen Switzerland (CH) Contact Jeton Tahiri jeton.tahiri@liebherr.com

jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You analyze diesel engines, components, and field data to identify lifecycle improvement through service, overhaul, remanufacturing and maintenance concepts
• You provide structured technical input to make-or-buy, repair-or-replace and remanufacturing evaluations based on quality findings, field experience and customer usage patterns
• You coordinate implementation of new improved aftermarket products with internal and external steakholders (Product Line, Engineering, Spare Parts, and Customers)
• You support the Aftermarket Portfolio Manager in prioritizing product initiatives based on technical evidence, implementation maturity and customer value
• You contribute to product standardization, cost- efficiency improvement of the aftermarket portfolio
• You manage related operational work packages from concept clarification through pilot implementation to final handover
• You maintain documentation, implementation status, open points, risks, decisions and escalation needs for assigned product initiatives
• You support testing, validation, knowledge transfer and product training for Customer Service Operations, Spare Parts and Business Development Your Profile
• You have completed studies in the technical field, industrial engineering, project management or industrial management
• You have several years of professional experience in engineering, product/project management, customer service, while experience in combustion engine applications is a plus
• You have good analytical skills and excellent knowledge of MS Office packages and are familiar with ERP systems
• You are fluent in German and/or French, and you possess very good English skills
• You are distinguished by strong ability to understand technical systems and translate findings into structured product and process requirements

jobs.title: Harness Designer (m/f/x) - Temporary Contract
jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You are responsible for the design and optimization of wiring harness assemblies for combustion engines, while taking into account technical, scheduling, and financial aspects (design-to-cost based on customer requirements)
• You prepare technical presentations and define the wiring harness topology and technology approach together with the E/E design team
• You create and manage 2D drawings. Having profound knowledge with Zuken E3 is a must. PTC CREO Cabling is an added value
• You create bill of materials for the wiring harness assembly
• You design and define the cabling components (electrical cables, connectors, fastening material) in accordance with standards, regulations, and functional requirements.
• You support the PLM system (BOM creation, lifecycle promotion, release process)
• You create and maintain technical documentation and component specifications
• You plan, execute and evaluate tests as part of the approval process for prototypes or series
• You cooperate with the corresponding departments within the project environment, as well as with component suppliers to clarify technical properties of components and support manufacturing related issues Your Profile
• You have completed your technical training or comparable qualifications in electro-mechanical design
• You have several years of experience in working in wiring harness design
• You have advanced knowledge of MS Office, Zuken E3, PTC Creo Cabling and PLM Albatros
• You are known for your autonomy and commitment, as well as your strong organizational skills. Flexible and resilient, you enjoy working in a multicultural environment. You are distinguished by your ability to innovate and your goal–oriented approach
• You are fluent in French, with ideally good knowledge of English and German
• You are willing to develop for the defense applications. Our Offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? jobs.title: Test Engineer (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You are in charge of the tests to be carried out in the workshop and on the test bench for the validation of the engine components during all the development phases to ensure the passage from prototype to pre-production
• You analyze the measurement results and report them in various standardized documents
• You control, validate and share the different reports with the teams concerned at an interdisciplinary level
• You work in close collaboration with the component technicians
• You collect test requests and validation plans. You analyze these requests and bring your technical expertise to discuss and adapt them if necessary. You transform the validation needs into appropriate test cycles
• You manage the planning of the tests. You make deviations and blocking points transparent
• You support and are involved in the resolution of problems related to engine components
• You participate in the continuous improvement of test procedures, processes and standardization of documents Your Profile
• You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering or similar
• You bring solid experience in engine development or a relevant field
• You have advanced knowledge in the field of combustion engines and DVPNr methodology
• You are comfortable with MS Office and have advanced knowledge of an ERP and of data analytics and post-processing software
• You stand out through your analytical mindset, reliability, resilience under pressure and strong commitment, combined with a collaborative and team-oriented approach

jobs.title: Tagetik Expert - Group Consolidation & Planning (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Tasks:
• Act as a partner to finance teams across the group, translating business requirements into robust Tagetik solutions across Consolidation, Planning, ESG, and Pillar 2 modules
• Design, build, and optimize Tagetik configurations, data flows, and reporting logic — hands-on
• Drive automation and integration between Tagetik, our ERP landscape, and BI tools, replacing manual interfaces with governed, scalable data flows
• Strengthen data governance and data integrity across the group's financial reporting processes, together with finance, IT, and operations
• Train and support key users worldwide, and act as the recognized Tagetik authority within the group Qualifications:
• You hold a degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, combined with proven delivery experience
• 5+ years of experience with CPM platforms in complex, multi-entity environments
• Deep, hands-on Tagetik expertise — this is non-negotiable. You have delivered at least one end-to-end consolidation or planning solution on Tagetik and can prove it
• Solid understanding of group accounting and consolidation logic (IFRS environment)
• Fluent English; German is a strong asset for daily work in Switzerland, French a plus
• Structured project mindset — you can hold your own in a large implementation with many moving parts Our offer:
• A rare chance to work on a full-scope Tagetik implementation at genuine group scale — the kind of project most specialists only see from the consulting side
• A permanent, in-house position with the stability of a family-owned group and none of the utilization pressure of consulting
• Hybrid working environment and advantageous benefits
• A small, senior corporate team where your expertise is visible and your decisions carry weight Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Regina Abou el Naga. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company Liebherr-International AG with its head office in Bulle is the holding company of the Liebherr Group and performs various functions in the areas finance, tax, auditing, legal, insurance, HR, and corporate communication. The Liebherr Group employs more than 55,000 people worldwide in over 150 countries. Location Liebherr-International AG General-Guisanstrasse 6 5415 Nussbaumen Switzerland (CH) Contact Regina Abou el Naga Regina.abouelnaga@liebherr.com

jobs.title: Data Architect-Enterprise Data Catalogue Lead (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
The Data Architect, Enterprise Data Catalogue Lead implements, rolls out, and operates Liebherr's Enterprise Data Catalogue, strengthening the strategic management of data assets across a complex, multi-domain landscape. Reporting to the Global Data Architect and working with Data Domain Architects, Corporate Data Governance, and business stakeholders, the role establishes and continuously improves the catalogue as a trusted source of information about the Group's data, aligned with corporate standards and governance. It suits someone who not only executes but proposes, takes initiative, and drives initiatives through to adoption. Responsibilities:
• Drive the implementation, deployment, and Group-wide rollout of the Enterprise Data Catalogue across a complex, heterogeneous system landscape, driving adoption across business and IT teams.
• Own the catalogue in operation: maintain, administer, and continuously improve it once live, ensuring data remains accurate, complete, and up to date.
• Design and configure metadata ingestion, data classification, and data lineage across multiple data domains and source systems.
• Lead the catalogue as a cross-functional initiative spanning all Group divisions, coordinating stakeholders toward a shared outcome.
• Define and run the operating model for the catalogue - onboarding new domains and sources, managing releases and upgrades, and monitoring usage and data quality over time.
• Proactively propose improvements to catalogue structure, governance processes, and adoption strategy.
• Support the definition of data standards and contribute to the evolution of the global data architecture.
• Document and manage system-agnostic data definitions across multiple data domains.
• Create and maintain conceptual and logical data models following corporate templates, including LeanIX modelling and architectural documentation.
• Collaborate closely with Data Domain Architects and Business Representatives to ensure consistency and quality.
• Support the coordination and implementation of data governance initiatives and frameworks. Competencies:
• A degree in Information Technology, Business Informatics, Data Management, or a related field.
• At least 5+ years of experience in data architecture or data governance, including hands-on implementation and operation of a data catalogue (e.g. Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Microsoft Purview, OpenMetadata, or DataHub).
• Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional projects across multiple divisions and stakeholder groups.
• Proven experience deploying, integrating, and running tooling in a complex, multi-source enterprise environment.
• Solid understanding of metadata management, data classification, and data lineage.
• Knowledge of data modelling techniques (conceptual, logical, physical) and data governance principles.
• A proactive, proposal-driven mindset, with proven experience of identifying gaps and driving improvements through to adoption.
• Strong stakeholder management and the ability to drive and sustain adoption across diverse business and IT teams.
• Knowledge of the SAP data model, knowledge graphs, or graph-based metadata models is a plus.
• Familiarity with LeanIX is preferred, or a strong willingness to learn.
• Broad knowledge of database systems (SQL and NoSQL) is a plus.
• Experience in manufacturing, industrial, or heavy equipment environments is a strong advantage.
• Fluent English required; German and French are a plus.
• Readiness for occasional travel. Our offer: We offer you a secure job, progressive and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, hybrid working and opportunities for further training. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Regina Abou el Naga. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The Liebherr Group employs more than 55,000 people worldwide in over 150 countries. Location Liebherr-International AG 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Regina Abou el Naga regina.abouelnaga@liebherr.com

jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You lead the development of Exhaust Aftertreatment Systems (EATS) from requirements and system design through testing, validation and PPAP
• You define technical specifications and requirements for EATS components and ensure their alignment with project targets
• You plan and coordinate development and validation activities, including test plans, prototype and calibration maturity, measurements and resources
• You coordinate EATS testing on engine test benches, analyses results and drive troubleshooting and problem-solving activities
• You manage DVPnR (Design Verification Plan and Reporting) activities and support Quality Gates, ensuring validation status, risks and deliverables are properly monitored and documented
• You work closely with Engine Development, Design, Purchasing and Quality to develop and integrate EATS solutions
• You act as the technical reference for EATS suppliers, from technology evaluation and component development to technical troubleshooting and 8D activities
• You contribute to the definition and maintenance of EATS-related software and technical documentation, and report development status to the project team Your Profile
• You have 3–5 years of experience in EATS, exhaust system or hardware development, ideally in the field of internal combustion engines
• You have solid knowledge of exhaust aftertreatment systems and catalyst technologies; experience with DEF dosing systems is an advantage
• You have experience in EATS testing, validation and calibration, including test planning, measurement and data analysis
• You have knowledge of EATS simulation (1D/3D, with basic CFD knowledge), FMEA and DVPnR methodology
• You are familiar with measurement and data acquisition tools such as CSM, Vector or ETAS and have a basic understanding of automotive software

jobs.title: Gas Engine Specialist (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You develop and share technical knowledge and expertise related to gas engines across the relevant development teams
• You collaborate with technical teams to define solutions in areas such as engine design, combustion, controls and application
• You analyze and assess technical requirements and specifications for gas engine applications
• You perform technical benchmark analyses of gas engine technologies for genset applications
• You lead root cause analyses and problem-solving activities for gas engine issues identified on test benches or in the field
• You collect and analyze customer requirements and translate them into technical and functional specifications
• You support technical discussions with customers and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, suppliers and subcontractors to ensure alignment with technical requirements, standards and processes
• You identify and develop innovative solutions to improve engine performance, quality, cost and efficiency while contributing to continuous improvement and knowledge management Your Profile
• You hold a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related technical field
• You have extensive professional experience in gas engine development, specifically for power generation applications
• You possess in-depth technical expertise in gas engines and have a strong understanding of current technologies and trends in the global gas engine market
• You have experience in the technical execution of complex gas engine development projects, from feasibility analysis through to implementation and production readiness
• You are fluent in English and German, knowledge of French is an advantage
• You have advanced knowledge of MS Office, MS Project, CRM and ERP systems
• You demonstrate excellent analytical and problem-solving skills and approach complex technical challenges in a structured manner Our Offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? jobs.title: Product Safety Specialist (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You apply and promote risk assessment processes in accordance with EN ISO 12100 and ensure their consistent application
• You coordinate the implementation of product risk assessments in collaboration with engineering and other relevant departments
• You ensure the implementation of applicable product safety requirements, guidelines and standards
• You support communication with customers and external stakeholders on product safety and risk assessment topics for specific projects
• You use your broad technical understanding to identify potential risks across mechanical, electrical, software and other technical aspects of our products
• You contribute to technical discussions and challenge existing solutions constructively from a product safety perspective Your Profile
• You have completed technical education or vocational training in a relevant field
• You have several years of professional experience in an industrial environment, ideally in machinery or heavy-duty equipment, basic knowledge in combustion engine technologies is an advantage
• You have a broad technical understanding covering areas such as technical drawings, mechanical design, hardware/software development and other relevant technologies
• You have practical knowledge of product safety and risk assessment, including experience with EN ISO 12100
• You have a good understanding of international product safety requirements and can translate them into practical solutions
• You are curious, eager to learn and comfortable working beyond your initial area of expertise
• You are confident and assertive in discussions, while remaining constructive and solution-oriented
• You are used to work autonomously, focused on clear targets

jobs.title: Group Senior Internal Auditor (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Die Liebherr-International AG ist die Dachgesellschaft der Firmengruppe Liebherr. Die Konzernrevision unterstützt Verwaltungsrat, Geschäftsleitung und Management durch unabhängige Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen bei der Weiterentwicklung von Governance-, Risiko- und Kontrollsystemen. As a Group Senior Internal Auditor, you will contribute to transparency, integrity, and sustainable business success across the Liebherr Group. Beyond evaluating processes and controls, you will act as a trusted advisor to management and support strategic improvement initiatives worldwide. Your Responsibilities:
• Independently plan and perform international audit engagements covering finance, operations, compliance, and governance topics
• Assess business processes, risks, and internal control systems to identify opportunities for improvement
• Develop practical and value-adding recommendations that enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and compliance
• Advise management on corporate governance, risk management, and internal control matters
• Support transformation initiatives, special projects, and strategic business developments from an audit and risk perspective
• Leverage data analytics and modern audit methodologies to enhance audit effectiveness and coverage
• Prepare concise, insightful, and audience-focused audit reports and present findings to local and senior management
• Monitor and evaluate the implementation of agreed corrective actions Your Profile:
• University degree in Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline
• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in internal audit, external audit, consulting, or a comparable role
• Professional certification such as Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) is preferred
• Strong understanding of business processes, governance structures, risk management, and internal controls
• High affinity for digital technologies, data analytics, and process automation
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills combined with sound business judgment
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all organizational levels
• Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently in an international environment
• Fluency in English and German; additional languages are an advantage
• Willingness to travel internationally approximately 30% Our Offer: Could we inspire you to take on a responsible role in a dynamic and independent family-owned company? We offer you the freedom to contribute your ideas, a secure workplace, and modern, family-friendly employment conditions, including flexible working hours, home office options, and opportunities for professional development and further training. What We Offer
• A challenging and rewarding role within a leading global family-owned industrial group
• Exposure to a wide range of businesses, industries, processes, and international environments
• Direct interaction with senior management and key decision-makers across the Group
• Opportunities to work on strategic projects, transformation initiatives, and emerging business risks
• A modern audit function that embraces innovation, data analytics, and continuous improvement
• Attractive career development opportunities within Internal Audit and across the wider Liebherr Group
• A collaborative culture that values integrity, curiosity, teamwork, and entrepreneurial thinking Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Regina Abou el Naga. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company Liebherr-International AG with its head office in Bulle is the holding company of the Liebherr Group and performs various functions in the areas finance, tax, auditing, legal, insurance, HR, and corporate communication. The Liebherr Group employs more than 55,000 people worldwide in over 150 countries. Location Liebherr-International AG General-Guisanstrasse 6 5415 Nussbaumen Switzerland (CH) Contact Regina Abou el Naga regina.abouelnaga@liebherr.com

• Laurea in Business Administration, Economia, Contabilità, Finanza, o una disciplina correlata

• La certificazione professionale come Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) è preferita
• Forte comprensione dei processi aziendali, delle strutture di governance, della gestione dei rischi e dei controlli interni
• Alta affinità per le tecnologie digitali, l'analisi dei dati e l'automazione dei processi

• Automotivata, proattiva e capace di lavorare in modo indipendente in un ambiente internazionale
• Fluency in inglese e tedesco; lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio
• Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale circa il 30% La nostra offerta: Possiamo ispirarvi a assumere un ruolo responsabile in una società familiare dinamica e indipendente? Vi offriamo la libertà di contribuire le vostre idee, un luogo di lavoro sicuro, e le condizioni di lavoro moderne e familiari, tra cui orari di lavoro flessibili, opzioni di ufficio domestico, e le opportunità per lo sviluppo professionale e formazione ulteriore. Cosa offriamo
• Un ruolo impegnativo e gratificante all'interno di un gruppo industriale di proprietà familiare
• Esposizione ad una vasta gamma di aziende, industrie, processi e ambienti internazionali
• Interazione diretta con senior management e decisori chiave in tutto il Gruppo
• Opportunità di lavorare su progetti strategici, iniziative di trasformazione e rischi aziendali emergenti
• Una moderna funzione di audit che abbraccia innovazione, analisi dei dati e miglioramento continuo
• Opportunità di sviluppo di carriera interessanti all'interno di Internal Audit e attraverso il più ampio Gruppo Liebherr
• Una cultura collaborativa che valorizza l'integrità, la curiosità, il lavoro di squadra e il pensiero imprenditoriale. Allora non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online. jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
• You will act as the primary interface between the company and designated Key Account customers, building long-term relationships and representing the organization across all relevant business areas.
• You will develop a thorough understanding of customer organizations, processes and requirements to identify business opportunities and increase the company's share of wallet.
• You will proactively monitor market developments, customer activities and competitor trends to support strategic decision-making and business growth.
• You will develop, implement and continuously update Key Account strategies and customer action plans in alignment with company objectives.
• You will prepare, coordinate and conduct customer reviews and strategic meetings to strengthen partnerships and support sustainable business development.
• You will lead and coordinate commercial activities, including negotiations, bid preparation, proposal management and follow-up to secure business opportunities.
• You will collaborate closely with management, product sales teams and other internal stakeholders to align customer requirements with company capabilities and priorities.
• You will monitor commercial performance and contribute to revenue and profitability growth in line with management expectations.
• You will ensure compliance with applicable Defense, security and regulatory requirements while handling sensitive information with the highest level of professionalism and confidentiality. Your profile
• You hold a university degree in a business or technical field, or an equivalent qualification supported by relevant professional experience in sales and account management .
• You have several years of experience in a similar role and a proven track record in managing strategic customer relationships and achieving commercial objectives.
• You possess an in-depth understanding of the Defense and military equipment market.
• You have a solid understanding of the regulatory, security and compliance requirements applicable to the Defense industry and are able to assess risks, recognize decision-making boundaries and escalate matters appropriately.
• You demonstrate a strong security and compliance mindset, handling sensitive and confidential information with discretion while consistently applying established rules and procedures, even under pressure.
• You are recognized for your strong commercial and customer-oriented mindset. Your enthusiastic and open personality, combined with excellent communication, adaptability, leadership, and stakeholder management skills, sets you apart. You are resilient, self-confident, and assertive in your approach.
